title: Dimensionally consistent surrogate modelling through dimensional analysis and harmonic expansions
abstract: arXiv:2609.38094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dimensional homogeneity is a fundamental constraint on physically meaningful models, requiring invariance under changes of units. We present a data-driven method for constructing surrogate models that satisfy this constraint at the level of the hypothesis class. Starting from a dimension matrix of measured variables, the method derives Buckingham $\Pi$-groups, constructs admissible dimensional prefactors, and approximates the remaining dimensionless dependence using truncated harmonic expansions on normalized invariant domains. Once the prefactor and dictionary are fixed, the coefficients are obtained from a regularized linear regression problem. We test the approach on the simple pendulum, Planck's black-body law, the double-pendulum Lyapunov field, and an experimental COBE/FIRAS black-body spectrum dataset. translated_title: 通过量纲分析与调和展开实现量纲一致的代理建模
translated_abstract: 量纲齐次性是物理上有意义的模型的一个基本约束，要求模型在单位变换下保持不变。我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法，用于在假设类层面上构建满足这一约束的代理模型。该方法从测量变量的量纲矩阵出发，推导出白金汉 Π 群，构造可容许的量纲前因子，并在归一化的不变域上使用截断调和展开来近似剩余的无量纲依赖关系。一旦前因子和字典被固定，系数即可通过一个正则化线性回归问题求得。我们在单摆、普朗克黑体辐射定律、双摆李雅普诺夫场以及COBE/FIRAS黑体光谱实验数据集上测试了该方法。结果表明，与无约束模型相比，量纲约束改善了数值条件性、对噪声的鲁棒性以及样本效率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合量纲分析与截断调和展开的数据驱动代理建模方法，在假设类层面强制满足量纲齐次性约束，从而显著提升了模型的数值条件性、抗噪鲁棒性和样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven surrogate modeling method combining dimensional analysis and truncated harmonic expansions that enforces dimensional homogeneity at the hypothesis-class level, improving conditioning, robustness to noise, and sample efficiency.
